FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Style Tailoring
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Stitch & Style Tailoring, we specialize in providing high-quality custom garment creation and alterations tailored to individual clients. Our operations include a dedicated team of skilled tailors who focus on personalized service, ensuring that each piece of clothing meets the unique specifications and style preferences of our customers. We primarily cater to clients seeking bespoke menswear, wedding attire, and clothing alterations. Our appointment-only fitting system allows for controlled customer flow, minimizing liability risks associated with walk-in traffic. Each garment is meticulously crafted in our clean, well-organized studio, equipped with the necessary sewing machines and tools to handle alterations and repairs, while ensuring compliance with all safety regulations. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail and customer satisfaction, making us a trusted choice in the Springfield community for tailored clothing solutions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a small fire caused by an electrical issue resulted in damage to sewing machines and fabric inventory, totaling $2,500. The claim was fully processed, and repairs have been completed, ensuring no future risks.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard 2-hour fireproof safe, class B, for securing cash and essential documents.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm monitoring with additional on-site security personnel during operational hours.

The business focuses on custom garment creation and alterations without any hazardous substance usage.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring does not sponsor athletic teams as it primarily focuses on custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients. The business model is centered around personalized service and does not involve community sponsorships or team affiliations.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our team consists of in-house skilled tailors dedicated to providing personalized services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Stitch & Style Tailoring has an active Workers' Compensation policy in place to cover employees as required by law. This ensures compliance with statutory obligations and provides protection for both the business and its workforce.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring does not own or operate any other business. It solely focuses on providing high-quality custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The only policy is the current liability policy in effect.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we focus solely on custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations focus exclusively on providing customized garment creation and alterations for individual clients. FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial record.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals, as our operations focus solely on custom garment creation and alterations without the use of such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring does not have any catastrophe exposure as its operations are focused on custom garment creation and alterations without significant risk factors related to natural disasters or similar events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize a respectful and compliant work environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Stitch & Style Tailoring has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all safety regulations and maintaining a safe working environment.
